q: The magnetic field is a region where _____ can be detected.
e: The magnetic field is a region where magnetic effects can be detected. A magnetic field line leaves the north pole and returns into the south pole involving where.

q: Distribution of magnetic field can be visualized by the _____.
e: Distribution of magnetic field can be visualized by the magnetic lines of force. Magnetic lines of force here means a push or pull that can change a body's state of motion. Electric lines of force: a push or pull that can change a body's state of motion.

q: The magnetic lines of force leave the _____ pole and enter the south pole.
e: The magnetic lines of force leave the north pole and enter the south pole. The physics in this sentence is built around north.

q: To show the pattern of a magnetic field around a bar magnet, we can sprinkle _____ lightly on a paper.
e: To show the pattern of a magnetic field around a bar magnet, we can sprinkle iron filings lightly on a paper. Iron filings here means the metal in magnetite and the common magnetic element.
The Earth has a magnetic field. Magnetic field here means the region around a magnet where magnetic effects show up.

q: We can think of the Earth as having an imaginary bar magnet inside it with magnetic north and _____ poles.
e: We can think of the Earth as having an imaginary bar magnet inside it with magnetic north and south poles. Every magnet has a north pole and a south pole, and like poles push apart.

q: The magnetic north lies somewhere in the sea in northern _____ but has been shifting slowly over the years.
e: The magnetic north lies somewhere in the sea in northern Canada but has been shifting slowly over the years. The physics in this sentence is built around Canada involving somewhere.

q: A magnetic field has neither a starting point nor an end point because magnets never have a _____.
e: A magnetic field has neither a starting point nor an end point because magnets never have a monopole. A magnetic field line leaves the north pole and returns into the south pole.
